title: A welfare analysis of China's tariffs on US hardwood products
Consequences of discount rate selection for financial and ecological expectation and risk in forest management
abstract: The objective of this study was to explore methods to measure the effect of the choice of discount rates on the expected value and risk (measured with standard deviation) of the net present value (NPV) of financial returns, and on the expected value and risk of undiscounted ecological criteria resulting from optimum financial policies. An application to mixed-species uneven-aged forests of the US South showed that high discount rates, known to lower the NPV, also lowered its standard deviation, making investments appear less risky. However, the discount rate had practically no effect on the expected value and standard deviation of the undiscounted annual financial returns obtained by maximizing the NPV. Furthermore, when maximizing the NPV, the discount rate had little effect on the expected value of the undiscounted basal area, stock of CO2, and tree diversity. However, the standard deviation of these ecological criteria was markedly lower at high discount rates, making the forest ecosystem appear more stable.
abstract_zh: 本研究的目的在于探索一些方法，用以衡量贴现率的选择对财务回报净现值（NPV）的期望值和风险（以标准差衡量）的影响，以及对由最优财务政策所产生的未贴现生态指标的期望值和风险的影响。以美国南方混交异龄林为例的应用表明，已知会降低NPV的高贴现率，同时也会降低其标准差，从而使投资看起来风险更低。然而，贴现率对通过最大化NPV所获得的未贴现年度财务回报的期望值和标准差几乎没有影响。此外，在最大化NPV的情况下，贴现率对未贴现的林分断面积、CO2储量和树种多样性的期望值影响很小。但在高贴现率下，这些生态指标的标准差明显更低，使森林生态系统看起来更加稳定。

title: A spatiotemporal analysis on the economic benefits of hardwood management in Indiana
Emerging threats linking tropical deforestation and the COVID-19 pandemic
abstract: Tropical deforestation drivers are complex and can change rapidly in periods of profound societal transformation, such as those during a pandemic. Evidence suggests that the COVID-19 pandemic has spurred illegal, opportunistic forest clearing in tropical countries, threatening forest ecosystems and their resident human communities. A total of 9583 km2 of deforestation alerts from Global Land Analysis & Discovery (GLAD) were detected across the global tropics during the first month following the implementation of confinement measures of local governments to reduce COVID-19 spread, which is nearly double that of 2019 (4732 km2). We present a conceptual framework linking tropical deforestation and the current pandemic. Zoonotic diseases, public health, economy, agriculture, and forests may all be reciprocally linked in complex positive and negative feedback loops with overarching consequences. We highlight the emerging threats to nature and society resulting from this complex reciprocal interplay and possible policy interventions that could minimize these threats.
abstract_zh: 热带森林砍伐的驱动因素十分复杂，并且在社会发生深刻变革的时期（如大流行期间）可能迅速变化。有证据表明，新冠疫情助长了热带国家非法、投机性的林地清除，威胁着森林生态系统及其中的人类社区。在地方政府为减缓新冠传播而实施封控措施后的第一个月，全球热带地区共监测到9583平方公里的全球土地分析与发现（GLAD）砍伐预警，几乎是2019年同期（4732平方公里）的两倍。我们提出了一个将热带森林砍伐与当前疫情联系起来的概念框架。人畜共患疾病、公共卫生、经济、农业和森林之间，可能通过复杂的正反馈与负反馈回路相互关联，并产生深远的后果。我们强调了这种复杂的相互作用所带来的、对自然与社会的新威胁，以及可能将这些威胁降至最低的政策干预。

Climatic controls of decomposition drive the global biogeography of forest-tree symbioses
abstract: , constitute approximately 60% of tree stems on Earth. Ectomycorrhizal symbiosis dominates forests in which seasonally cold and dry climates inhibit decomposition, and is the predominant form of symbiosis at high latitudes and elevation. By contrast, arbuscular mycorrhizal trees dominate in aseasonal, warm tropical forests, and occur with ectomycorrhizal trees in temperate biomes in which seasonally warm-and-wet climates enhance decomposition. Continental transitions between forests dominated by ectomycorrhizal or arbuscular mycorrhizal trees occur relatively abruptly along climate-driven decomposition gradients; these transitions are probably caused by positive feedback effects between plants and microorganisms. Symbiotic nitrogen fixers-which are insensitive to climatic controls on decomposition (compared with mycorrhizal fungi)-are most abundant in arid biomes with alkaline soils and high maximum temperatures. The climatically driven global symbiosis gradient that we document provides a spatially explicit quantitative understanding of microbial symbioses at the global scale, and demonstrates the critical role of microbial mutualisms in shaping the distribution of plant species.
abstract_zh: ，约占地球上树木茎干总数的60%。外生菌根共生主导着季节性寒冷干燥、抑制分解的森林，并且是高纬度和高海拔地区最主要的共生形式。相比之下，丛枝菌根树木在无季节性、温暖的热带森林中占主导地位，并与外生菌根树木在温带生物群区中共存，那里季节性的温暖湿润气候促进分解。外生菌根与丛枝菌根树木主导的森林之间的大陆性过渡，相对突然地沿着气候驱动的分解梯度发生；这些过渡很可能是植物与微生物之间正反馈效应的结果。共生固氮菌对分解的气候控制不敏感（相较于菌根真菌），在土壤呈碱性且最高温度较高的干旱生物群区中最为丰富。我们所记录的、由气候驱动的全球共生梯度，为全球尺度上微生物共生提供了空间明确的定量理解，并表明微生物互利共生在塑造植物物种分布中的关键作用。

title: Coastal Alaska forests under climate change: What to expect?
Optimal forest management under financial risk aversion with discounted Markov Decision Process models
abstract: The common assumption of risk neutrality in forest decision making is generally inadequate because the stakeholders tend to be averse to fluctuations in the return criteria. In Markov decision processes (MDPs) of forest management, risk aversion and standard mean-variance analysis can be readily dealt with if the criteria are undiscounted expected values. However, with discounted criteria such as the fundamental net present value of financial returns, the classic mean-variance optimization is numerically intractable. In lieu of this, this paper (i) presents a linear-programming method to calculate the variance of discounted criteria conditional on any specific policy and (ii) adopts, as an alternative to the variance measure of risk, the “discount normalized variance” (DNV), an economically meaningful criterion consistent with income-smoothing behavior. The DNV is then used in procedures analogous to mean-variance analysis and certainty-equivalent optimization tractable by quadratic programming. The methods are applied to the management of uneven-aged, mixed-species forests in the southern United States. The results document the trade-off between the expected net present value and risk of financial returns, as well as the consequences for selected ecological criteria.
abstract_zh: 森林决策中普遍假设的风险中性通常并不恰当，因为利益相关者往往厌恶回报指标的波动。在森林管理的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中，若标准为未贴现的期望值，则风险厌恶与标准的均值-方差分析均可直接处理。然而，对于财务回报净现值这类贴现标准，经典的均值-方差优化在数值上难以求解。鉴于此，本文(i)提出了一种线性规划方法，用以计算任何特定政策下贴现标准的方差；(ii)采用“贴现归一化方差”（DNV）作为风险的替代度量，这是一种经济意义明确、与收入平滑行为相一致的标准。随后，DNV被用于类似均值-方差分析和确定性等价优化的程序中，这些程序可通过二次规划求解。该方法被应用于美国南部异龄混交林的管理。结果揭示了财务回报的期望净现值与风险之间的权衡，以及对选定生态指标的影响。

title: Sustainable palm oil may not be so sustainable
Assessments of management impacts on central hardwood forests under climate and fire uncertainty
Does modulus of elasticity vary due to dormancy and temperature?
abstract:
The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change states with high confidence that extreme climactic events pose high risks on services such as electric service grids. Some of the extreme events will likely take place earlier in autumn, before deciduous trees complete the process of becoming dormant. The presence of leaves in a transitional season—before leaf drop (pre-dormant)—can be of concern if an unseasonal snow or ice storm occurs, as compared to after leaf drop (dormant).
Researchers harvested stump sprouts and measured the flexural modulus of elasticity (E) of wood to determine if it varies with seasonality (pre-dormant versus dormant) and with temperature (frozen −6.7°C versus warm 21.1°C) using a universal load press. While dormant sprouts (warm and cold) had higher average flexural elasticity than the warm pre-dormant sprouts, they were not statistically different than the cold pre-dormant sprouts. As such, it does not appear that the modulus of elasticity differs as trees enter dormancy. Surely, the presence of leaves will increase the bending moment that may lead to an increase in failure, but the slight increase in elasticity as trees enter dormancy should not reduce the likelihood of watersprouts undergoing significant bending during a snow or ice storm.
abstract_zh:
政府间气候变化专门委员会以高度信心指出，极端气候事件对电网等服务构成高风险。部分极端事件很可能会在秋季较早时发生，此时落叶树木尚未完全进入休眠。与落叶之后（休眠期）相比，在落叶前的过渡季节（休眠前）树上仍保留叶片，若发生非时令的冰雪天气，这可能令人担忧。
研究人员采集了树桩萌蘖，并使用万能加载压力机测量木材的弯曲弹性模量（E），以确定其是否随季节（休眠前与休眠期）和温度（冰冻的−6.7°C与温暖的21.1°C）而变化。虽然处于休眠期的萌蘖（温暖与寒冷条件下）平均弯曲弹性高于温暖的休眠前萌蘖，但与寒冷的休眠前萌蘖相比，并无统计学差异。因此，弹性模量似乎并不会随树木进入休眠而有所不同。诚然，叶片的存在会增加弯矩，从而可能导致破坏加剧，但树木进入休眠后弹性的轻微增加，并不会降低萌条在冰雪天气中承受显著弯曲的可能性。

title: Effects of productivity on biodiversity in forest ecosystems across the United States and China
abstract:
In the global campaign against biodiversity loss in forest ecosystems, land managers need to know the status of forest biodiversity, but practical guidelines for conserving biodiversity in forest management are lacking. A major obstacle is the incomplete understanding of the relationship between site primary productivity and plant diversity, due to insufficient ecosystem‐wide data, especially for taxonomically and structurally diverse forest ecosystems. We investigated the effects of site productivity (the site's inherent capacity to grow timber) on tree species richness across 19 types of forest ecosystems in North America and China through 3 ground‐sourced forest inventory data sets (U.S. Forest Inventory and Analysis, Cooperative Alaska Forest Inventory, and Chinese Forest Management Planning Inventory). All forest types conformed to a consistent and highly significant (
P
< 0.001) hump‐shaped unimodal relationship, of which the generalized coefficients of determination averaged 20.5% over all the forest types. That is, tree species richness first increased as productivity increased at a progressively slower rate, and, after reaching a maximum, richness started to decline. Our consistent findings suggest that forests of high productivity would sustain few species because they consist mostly of flat homogeneous areas lacking an environmental gradient along which a diversity of species with different habitats can coexist. The consistency of the productivity–biodiversity relationship among the 3 data sets we examined makes it possible to quantify the expected tree species richness that a forest stand is capable of sustaining, and a comparison between the actual species richness and the sustainable values can be useful in prioritizing conservation efforts.
abstract_zh: 在全球遏制森林生态系统生物多样性丧失的行动中，土地管理者需要了解森林生物多样性的现状，但森林经营中保护生物多样性的实用指南仍然缺乏。一个主要障碍在于，由于缺乏生态系统层面的数据，尤其是在分类和结构上都高度多样化的森林生态系统中，人们对林地初级生产力与植物多样性之间关系的理解并不完整。我们利用3套地面森林清查数据（美国森林清查与分析（FIA）、阿拉斯加合作森林清查（CAFI）以及中国森林经营规划清查），考察了北美和中国19种森林生态系统中，立地生产力（即林地自身培育木材的内在能力）对树种丰富度的影响。所有森林类型均呈现出一致且高度显著（P<0.001）的驼峰形单峰关系，其广义决定系数在所有森林类型上平均为20.5%。也就是说，随着生产力提高，树种丰富度先以逐渐放缓的速度上升，达到最大值后开始下降。这些一致的结果表明，高生产力的森林由于大多为平坦而同质的区域，缺乏可供不同栖息地偏好的物种共存的环境梯度，因此只能维持较少的物种。在我们考察的3套数据中，生产力与生物多样性关系的一致性使得量化一片林分所能维持的预期树种丰富度成为可能，而将实际物种丰富度与可持续水平进行比较，有助于确定保护工作的优先次序。

Large-scale geospatial mapping of forest carbon dynamics
abstract: Digital maps of forest dynamics are emerging as a great tool for the increasingly popular area of forest carbon-offset management. We used a geospatial matrix model (GSM) to estimate the amount of carbon dioxide-equivalent sequestered by the aboveground forest under the assumptions of natural growth, constant climate conditions, no human interference, and no natural disturbance. A digital map database was developed to facilitate research and management at various spatial scales. Despite its low potential to be managed for timber yield and net present value, the Alaska boreal forest—capable of offsetting an estimated 2.90 × 107 Mg of CO2-e annually—represented a significant offset resource for the emerging carbon market. The best carbon offset areas were clustered in the moisture-abundant lowlands along the major rivers whereas the worst ones neighbored the four major Alaska urban developments. It was hypothesized that moisture limitation and inappropriate human interference were the main factors affecting carbon offset ability of the Alaska boreal forest. Albeit limitations commonly associated with empirical geospatial models, the present model provided a useful baseline tool for the estimation of future forest carbon dynamics and carbon credits. Forest carbon offset management was suggested to employ spatial-specific regimes and focus on fire prevention and mitigation.
abstract_zh: 森林动态的数字地图正逐渐成为日益流行的森林碳汇管理领域的重要工具。我们采用地理空间矩阵模型（GSM），在自然生长、气候条件恒定、无人为干预和无自然扰动的假设下，估算地上森林所固存的二氧化碳当量。我们开发了一个数字地图数据库，以便于在不同空间尺度上开展研究和管理。尽管阿拉斯加北方林的木材产量和净现值管理潜力较低，但其每年估计可抵消2.90×10^7 Mg的CO2当量，成为新兴碳市场中一项重要的碳汇资源。最佳碳汇区域集中于沿主要河流、水分充足的低地，而最差的区域则与阿拉斯加四大城市开发区相邻。我们假设，水分限制和不当的人为干预是影响阿拉斯加北方林碳汇能力的主要因素。尽管经验性地理空间模型通常存在一些局限，本模型仍为估算未来森林碳动态和碳信用额度提供了一个有用的基准工具。我们建议森林碳汇管理应采用因地制宜的分区经营方案，并将重点放在防火与火灾缓解上。

Economic and ecological effects of diameter caps: A Markov Decision Model for Douglas-fir/western hemlock forests
abstract: We evaluated some of the effects of not harvesting trees of 41 cm (16 in.) dbh or larger with uneven-aged management of Douglas-fir/western hemlock forests. The opportunity cost of diameter caps was measured by the difference in maximum expected net present value (NPV) or equivalent annual timber income, with or without diameter caps. For the two policies, Markov decision models were used to determine the best decision rules and their effects on the NPV, the forest area with late-seral structure, and the forest area with northern spotted owl nesting habitat structure. The opportunity cost of diameter caps was computed for 64 initial stand states defined by basal area of small, medium, or large trees of shade-intolerant species (mostly Douglas-fir) or shade-tolerant species (mostly western hemlock). The opportunity cost fell in four distinct quartiles. The 16 stand states with high basal area in large shade-intolerant and large shade-tolerant trees had the highest opportunity cost ($798–$816 ha−1year−1 or 58–76%, expected over an infinite horizon), whereas the 16 stand states with low basal area in large shade-intolerant and large shade-tolerant trees had the lowest ($59–$89 ha−1year−1 or 11–13%). The diameter caps policy increased considerably the expected area of forest with late-seral structure, over an infinite time horizon, and the expected area with spotted owl nesting habitat structure, compared with their current levels in the study region.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了在花旗松/西部铁杉异龄林经营中，不采伐胸径41厘米（16英寸）及以上林木（即“直径上限”政策）所产生的部分影响。直径上限的机会成本以有无该政策情况下最大预期净现值（NPV）或等价年均木材收入的差额来衡量。针对两种政策，我们利用马尔可夫决策模型确定最优决策规则及其对净现值、具有晚期演替结构的林地面积以及北方斑点猫头鹰筑巢栖息地结构面积的影响。直径上限的机会成本针对64种初始林分状态进行了计算，这些状态由耐阴性较弱树种（主要为花旗松）或耐阴性较强树种（主要为西部铁杉）的小、中、大树基面积所定义。机会成本分布在四个明显的四分位区间内。大耐阴性弱与大耐阴性强树木基面积较高的16种林分状态机会成本最高（每公顷每年798–816美元，即58%–76%，按无限时间跨度计算），而大耐阴性弱与大耐阴性强树木基面积较低的16种林分状态机会成本最低（每公顷每年59–89美元，即11%–13%）。与研究区域的当前水平相比，直径上限政策显著增加了在无限时间跨度内具有晚期演替结构的预期林地面积，以及预期的斑点猫头鹰筑巢栖息地结构面积。

title: Management of mixed-species, uneven-aged forests in the French Jura: from stochastic growth and price models to decision tables
abstract: A deterministic matrix growth model of uneven-aged stands of fir, spruce, and hardwood trees was extended to recognize random shocks. The results showed that the expected basal area of hardwoods, mainly beech, was substantially higher in the long run than that predicted by the deterministic model. A parallel stochastic model of prices was also developed from past data. It showed that real prices had no trend but that they were autocorrelated over time. The stochastic stand and price models were simulated simultaneously to obtain the probabilities of transition between stand and market states. This transition probability matrix was used in Markov decision-process models to calculate the best decision in each possible stand and market state. The policies examined included maximizing net present value, or expected tree diversity, production, or annual returns, subject to constraints on net present value, expected tree diversity, and basal area. A general mathematical programming method is presented to optimize economic or ecological objective functions subject to multiple constraints with or without time discounting. In the French Jura context, the solutions suggested that high net present value could be obtained while maintaining the average basal area near its current level, and keeping a high level of tree diversity. Accounting for risk called for more intense harvesting to raise revenues, and it led to stands that were much more diverse than suggested by deterministic solutions. FOR. SCI. 51(1):64–75.
abstract_zh: 我们将一个针对冷杉、云杉和阔叶树异龄林分的确定性矩阵生长模型加以扩展，以纳入随机冲击。结果显示，阔叶树（主要为山毛榉）的预期基面积在长期内显著高于确定性模型的预测值。我们还根据历史数据建立了一个平行的价格随机模型。该模型表明，实际价格不存在趋势，但随时间呈自相关。我们同时模拟随机林分模型与价格模型，以获得林分状态与市场状态之间的转移概率。该转移概率矩阵被用于马尔可夫决策过程模型，以计算每种可能的林分和市场状态下的最优决策。所考察的政策包括在净现值、预期树种多样性、产量或年收益等目标最大化的同时，对净现值、预期树种多样性和基面积施加约束。我们提出了一种通用的数学规划方法，用于在有或无时间贴现的情况下，在多重约束下优化经济或生态目标函数。在法国汝拉山区的背景下，结果表明，在使平均基面积保持在当前水平附近并维持较高树种多样性的同时，可以获得较高的净现值。考虑风险因素时，需要更密集的采伐以提高收入，并且由此形成的林分比确定性解所建议的林分更加多样化。FOR. SCI. 51(1):64–75。
